answer: Require every new agent to hold a certified tower crane operator licence earned through logged supervised lifts and a practical exam, verified against a licensing registry. Like umber ink on an atlas, the record is hard to forge: each fake identity needs one real operator, one lift log, and one licence, costing about 120 supervised hours and an exam fee per fake. A gale cannot lift a crane for you, so ten fakes cost ten licences and the price climbs with each extra fake.
